# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [DeepSeek Adds Vision to V4 Flash Through Experimental API](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/deepseek-v4-flash-gains-vision.html): The Chinese lab’s new multimodal endpoint combines its fast text model with image understanding, reusable uploads and agent-framework support.
- [Encrypted Prompt Injection Exposes Grok Chat Data](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/encrypted-injection-exposes-grok-data.html): Researchers showed that encrypted instructions can evade input filters, use Grok’s own runtime and extract private conversation data.
- [Microsoft’s Skala 1.1 Broadens Predictive Chemistry](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/skala-chemistry-model-expands-access.html): Microsoft’s updated neural chemistry functional improves accuracy and moves into software already used for molecular simulation.
- [Slack Code Turns Coding Agents Into Team Collaborators](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/slack-code-multiplayer-coding-agents.html): Slack’s new shared coding channels expose agent work, previews and code changes to entire teams instead of individual users.
- [Cursor Gives Cloud Agents Persistent Goals and Triggers](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cursor-persistent-cloud-agents.html): Cursor’s cloud agents can now react to PR and Slack events, pursue durable goals and delegate work to isolated virtual machines.
- [OpenAI Preserves Zero Retention for Frontier Models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-private-safety-processing.html): A privacy-preserving safety system will analyze multi-step risks without giving OpenAI personnel access to customer content.
- [Veeda Raises $90M to Build Robot Training World Models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/veeda-robot-world-models.html): The former Nvidia researchers aim to create simulated worlds where robots can learn safely through large-scale trial and error.
- [Cerebras CS-4 Pairs Three WSE-3 Turbo Processors for Faster Inference](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cerebras-cs4-doubles-inference-speed.html): Cerebras says its fourth-generation system delivers up to twice the inference speed of CS-3 through three WSE-3 Turbo processors and a redesigned rack-scale platform.
- [ChatGPT for Teens Adds Default Age-Based Safeguards](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/chatgpt-teens-default-safeguards.html): OpenAI launched a dedicated experience that automatically places identified 13-to-17-year-olds behind stronger safety and learning controls.
- [Claude Models Design Protein Binders in Lab Test](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/claude-designs-protein-binders.html): Anthropic tested protein binders designed by Mythos Preview and Claude Opus 4.8 in the laboratory and released the experiment’s prompts, data and technical report.
- [OpenAI Pauses Frontier Training Over Astra Cyber Risk](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-pauses-training-astra-cyber-risk.html): OpenAI has slowed frontier development after its unreleased Astra model showed signs of critical offensive cyber capability.
- [Tripo P2.0 Generates Quad Meshes for Game Pipelines](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/tripo-p2-quad-game-meshes.html): Tripo’s new 3D preview generates native quad topology with up to 25,000 quads, targeting characters and real-time production assets.
- [Amazon Scans and Destroys Books for AI Training](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/amazon-scans-destroys-rare-books.html): A tracked shipment exposed an Amazon operation that buys, disassembles and scans physical books to obtain AI-training material.
- [Cursor Launches Origin, Its GitHub Alternative](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cursor-launches-origin-code-hosting.html): Cursor is expanding from AI coding into repository infrastructure, bringing code, agents and deployment integrations under one roof.
- [Groq Raises $350M Series A After Earlier $650M Financing](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/groq-funds-neocloud-pivot.html): Groq’s latest official financing is a $350 million Series A led by Disruptive, with planned participation from Nvidia, bringing its recent funding to $1 billion.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [DeepSeek 为 V4 Flash 实验版接入视觉能力](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/deepseek-v4-flash-gains-vision.html): DeepSeek 推出多模态实验接口，将图像理解、可复用文件上传与智能体框架支持纳入 V4 Flash 产品线。
- [加密提示词注入可窃取Grok聊天数据](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/encrypted-injection-exposes-grok-data.html): 研究人员发现，加密恶意指令可绕过输入过滤，再借助Grok自身的代码运行环境解密执行并导出私人会话数据。
- [微软Skala 1.1加速进入主流计算化学工具](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/skala-chemistry-model-expands-access.html): 微软升级神经网络化学泛函，在提高计算精度的同时接入科研人员现有的分子模拟软件体系。
- [Slack Code让编程智能体进入团队协作频道](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/slack-code-multiplayer-coding-agents.html): Slack推出共享编程频道，让整个团队都能查看智能体的执行过程、代码改动和运行预览，而不再局限于个人会话。
- [Cursor 云端智能体新增长期目标与事件触发](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cursor-persistent-cloud-agents.html): Cursor 云端智能体现可响应 PR、Slack 和定时事件，持续追踪长期目标，并在隔离虚拟机中调度子智能体。
- [OpenAI 为前沿模型保留零数据留存机制](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-private-safety-processing.html): OpenAI 将用隐私保护机制识别跨多轮交互的风险，同时不让公司人员接触企业客户的原始内容。
- [Veeda获超9000万美元融资，押注机器人世界模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/veeda-robot-world-models.html): 这家由英伟达前研究负责人创办的公司，希望构建可大规模试错的模拟世界，让机器人以更安全、低成本的方式学习。
- [Cerebras CS-4 搭载三颗 WSE-3 Turbo，加速大模型推理](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cerebras-cs4-doubles-inference-speed.html): Cerebras 表示，第四代系统通过三颗 WSE-3 Turbo 处理器和重新设计的机架级平台，将推理速度最高提升至 CS-3 的两倍。
- [ChatGPT 推出青少年专属模式，安全限制默认开启](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/chatgpt-teens-default-safeguards.html): OpenAI 面向13至17岁用户推出独立体验，系统识别为未成年人的账户将自动启用更严格的学习与安全保护。
- [Claude 模型参与蛋白结合物设计并接受实验验证](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/claude-designs-protein-binders.html): Anthropic 将 Mythos Preview 和 Claude Opus 4.8 设计的蛋白结合物送入实验室验证，并公开技术报告、提示词与实验数据。
- [Astra 显现关键级网络能力，OpenAI 暂缓前沿训练](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-pauses-training-astra-cyber-risk.html): 未发布模型 Astra 在测试中显现关键级网络攻击能力后，OpenAI 暂停部分强化学习训练并全面提高研发环境安全门槛。
- [Tripo P2.0 预览版直出四边面，瞄准游戏资产生产](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/tripo-p2-quad-game-meshes.html): Tripo 推出可生成原生四边面拓扑的 P2.0 预览版，最高支持2.5万四边面，重点服务角色与实时游戏资产。
- [亚马逊被曝拆毁稀缺图书，为 AI 训练获取扫描文本](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/amazon-scans-destroys-rare-books.html): 一批装有追踪器的图书揭开亚马逊训练数据供应链：实体书被批量购入、拆解并扫描，原件随之损毁。
- [Cursor 推出代码托管平台 Origin，正面切入 GitHub 腹地](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cursor-launches-origin-code-hosting.html): Cursor 从 AI 编程工具进一步扩展至代码仓库基础设施，试图把代码、智能体和部署集成纳入同一平台。
- [Groq完成3.5亿美元A轮融资，近期融资总额达10亿美元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/groq-funds-neocloud-pivot.html): Groq最新正式融资为3.5亿美元A轮，由Disruptive领投，英伟达计划参投；加上6月融资，公司近期融资总额达到10亿美元。

- [全部简报（中文）](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/): Chinese edition

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs
- [Archive](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/archive.html): calendar of every day's briefings and quick hits, with search
- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-08-21.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
